visible_highlights: High-top knit slip-on shoes with a ribbed sock-style collar and EVA sole. The lace-free front keeps the shape clean, while the tall opening distinguishes it from a low-cut sneaker. Black White and All Black provide contrast and monochrome choices through EU 35–45.
visible_faq_text: FAQs Which color and EU size choices are listed? All Black: EU 35–45; Black/White: EU 35–45. What should I check on this sock-style opening? Check how the ribbed high collar passes over the instep and sits around the ankle. This is a slip-on construction with no conventional laces; assess toe room and heel hold with the intended socks. What is the minimum order for the original style? The listed original-style minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; logo and custom packaging proposals are quoted separately. How can I request a sample? Send the selected color or lining option, EU size and delivery postcode for a sample quotation covering the pair, courier charge and proposed dispatch date. What should I send for logo or packaging requirements? Send the logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. The proposal for this style will set out the applicable minimum, cost and sample process. How can I get a delivered quotation? Send pair quantities by color and EU size, the destination postcode or port and the packaging request. The quotation separates product cost and freight and includes the proposed dispatch and transit schedule.
